item.title: Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until Iran’s conditions are met: Army chief
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Chief Commander of the Islamic Republic of Iran, Army Major General Amir Hatami, has reiterated Iran’s resolve to safeguard national interests, saying the acceptance of seven conditions put forward to the United States is the only way to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

Tehran, IRNA — Chief Commander of the Islamic Republic of Iran, Army Major General Amir Hatami, has reiterated Iran’s resolve to safeguard national interests, saying the acceptance of seven conditions put forward to the United States is the only way to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran has no intention of transferring enriched uranium abroad: Diplomat
item.description: Moscow, IRNA — Mojtaba Ferdowsipoor, head of the Iranian Interests Section in Cairo, has rejected the speculations that the Islamic Republic will transfer its enriched uranium abroad, stressing that the stockpile will remain in the country and under the supervision of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86331069/Iran-has-no-intention-of-transferring-enriched-uranium-abroad

Moscow, IRNA — Mojtaba Ferdowsipoor, head of the Iranian Interests Section in Cairo, has rejected the speculations that the Islamic Republic will transfer its enriched uranium abroad, stressing that the stockpile will remain in the country and under the supervision of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).
